claim_boundary.claim_if_null: Stage 26/27A component-path evidence remains valid, but the component path did not recover hard-partner token contrast under the preregistered sonar metric.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: For Pythia-160M Stage 7 Foundation classes, hard-partner token signatures become more discriminative when measured through the causally validated component path than through static unembedding alone.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim exact neurons, complete circuits, raw CAS-symbol understanding, internal CAS compiler behavior, 40-Element component causality, free-form generation control, or cross-model component generality from Stage 27B.
claim_boundary.scope_boundary: Stage 27B is Foundation-first because the selected head path was validated on the Stage 7 Foundation readout. Original TKS 40-Element sonar remains a follow-on until a 40-Element component path is separately localized and path-patched.

formal_anchor: Coverage-family framing: the selected attention-head family is treated as a local covering family for the Stage 7 Foundation readout. The sonar is measured on the component-path delta, not on an unlocalized residual-stream direction.

gates.criterion: Stage 7 activation artifact hash matches the locked manifest.
gates.name: artifact_contract

gates.criterion: Stage 26 and Stage 27A source reports are PASS and selected components match the top-six family.
gates.name: component_path_contract

gates.criterion: Readable token-signature rate is at least 50%.
gates.name: readable_signature_floor

gates.criterion: Mean selected component-path target-minus-hard-partner token margin is positive.
gates.name: hard_partner_margin

gates.criterion: At least 55% of evaluated rows have positive target-minus-hard-partner token margin.
gates.name: positive_share

gates.criterion: Selected component-path margin exceeds matched patch-control margins with empirical p < 0.05.
gates.name: matched_component_control

method: Refit the locked Stage 7 28-way Foundation probe on the locked layer-6 focus-token artifact.
Project Foundation probe directions through Pythia-160M output embeddings to define readable target and hard-partner token sets.
On held-out Stage 7 rows, run baseline, selected-head ablation, and selected-head patch-restoration forwards.
Compute the component-path token-logit delta as patched_hidden - ablated_hidden at the locked readout position.
For each target/hard-partner row, score mean(delta logits on target token set) minus mean(delta logits on hard-partner token set).
Compare the selected-component path against same-layer/same-kind matched patch controls.
Report overall and pair-family breakdowns for same-drive/different-register and different-drive/same-register hard partners.
motivation: Static sonar sees broad CAS token geometry but fails hard-local contrast. Stage 27B tests the solution suggested by Stage 26/27A: measure token signatures through the component path that causally carries the Foundation readout.
